fields.Name: T86 - Products Awards Drilldown
fields.Description: Verifies a Product's related Competition Entries or Product Awards can be reached from the full record form and that related rows render or a valid empty-state shows.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, go to Data Explorer (Data section) and open the 'Products' entity from the entity tree. Select a product such as 'Truffle Brie' (or any product) and click 'Open Full Record' to load the full form. On that form, locate the related Competition Entries or Product Awards section/tab and view it, confirming related rows are displayed, or a valid empty-state for a product with no entries. Pages can take 10-30s to load - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Product full record form is open showing product detail fields
A related Competition Entries or Product Awards section/tab is visible with related rows or a clear empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
